name: default-branch-drift
description: Report whether the default branch on the remote has moved ahead of the local one. Read-only: it uses the repository's own tracking refs, fetches nothing and can never change the tree.
prompt: Report whether the remote's default branch has moved ahead of the local default branch of this repository. Use only the read-only git tools: call git.status for the current branch and head, then git.diff with base set to the local default branch and target set to its remote-tracking ref (origin/<default-branch>) to see what differs. Do not fetch, merge, pull, checkout or write any file. Finish with task.complete and a summary that says one of: up to date, behind by the listed files, or cannot tell (and why).

inputs.name: default_branch
inputs.description: The name of the default branch to compare.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Whether the default branch has moved ahead, and the files that differ.
